newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 4.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 4.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:

* On Thursday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 100.43 points, or 1.29 percent, at 7,895.81, as a key jobs report improved chances that the Federal Reserve would hold U.S. interest rates steady.
* Indonesia is likely to announce a package of economic deregulation measures after a mini-cabinet meeting on Friday, government sources said.

Sources in the finance ministry said the long-delayed deregulation package was complete and would be on the agenda. Barring any last minute hitches, the measures should be announced later in the day, they said.

* On Thursday, the Jakarta composite index ended 5.34 points, or 0.73 percent higher, at a record high of 735.49 for the second consecutive day following a late spurt of foreign-led buying in blue-chips, brokers said.
* On Friday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,430.50/31.00 at 0130 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,431.50/32.00.
* Distribution firm Tira Austenite on reports it has sold half of its 20-percent stake in energy firm PT Aneka Gas Industri.
* Property firm Surya Semesta on reports it planned to spend $55 million on a new luxury resort on the island of Bali.
* Property firm Duta Pertiwi on announcement of a 350 billion rupiah bond issue to pay bank loans and strengthen working capital.
* Pharmaceutical firm Tempo Scan on a report in Bisnis Indonesia daily that a founding shareholder had sold 20 million shares, or a 13 percent stake, through a private placement.
* Medium-sized Bank Bahari following its debut on Tuesday. The bank listed 262 million shares on the Jakarta exchange.
